online.titulo: What an online lesson is like
online.intro: One-to-one video lessons with a Costa Rican teacher. He is based in Switzerland, so there are slots that work for both Europe and the Americas.
online.paso1Texto: Times are shown in your own zone and in Costa Rica's, so there are no surprises.
online.paso2Texto: With a PayPal deposit. You settle the rest directly with your teacher.
online.paso3Texto: You get the video call link. Lessons are conversation from day one, not exercise filler.
online.profesorTexto: A Costa Rican living in Switzerland. He teaches the Spanish actually spoken in Costa Rica: the voseo, the slang and the tone, not just textbook grammar.

hero.subtitulo: Immersion in Manuel Antonio, Sámara, La Fortuna or San José. A lesson in the morning and the whole country as your classroom afterwards.
hero.fotoAlt: A steep street in San José, houses painted in bright colours and power lines crossing from side to side

presencial.intro: Living where the language is spoken is what makes it stick.
presencial.texto: The shape is always the same: a small-group lesson in the morning and the rest of the day outside, ordering at a soda, asking the time at the corner shop, or working out the bus. Vocabulary learned that way does not fade, because you used it the same day. You can go for fifteen days or two months; the longer you stay, the more it shows.
presencial.dondeTexto: In each destination we work with a local immersion school. Those agreements are still being closed, so we are not publishing timetables or prices for each one yet: tell us in the form what you are after and we will tell you what is available at that destination.

destinos.intro: Four places, each with its own school and its own reason to pick it. In all of them you study in the morning and go out to practise afterwards.
